description: Local UI Server Function input (FM-1; fewer manual steps design 2.1): add one row of the login stage table of a job to the auth setup on the spot, after the confirmation dialog. The row is chosen as in ui-login-stage-row-key; expectedProfileRevision is the profile revision the dialog showed. The server builds the auth setup again from the job record and saves it with saveProfileAndAuthSetup (the profile revision advances).
